notes: P05 algorithmic property/metamorphic test suite for SACMAT 2027 (PolicyTrace: Temporal Conformance Testing of Delegated Consent across Heterogeneous Policy Engines). tests/venue2027/sacmat/test_algorithm_properties.py drives ONLY the REAL SACMAT algorithmic surfaces: the three in-process engine models (XacmlPolicyEngine deny-overrides, CedarPolicyEngine forbid precedence, ZanzibarPolicyEngine read-time relation walk), the independent four-valued oracle (oracle_decision) and arm dispatch B0/B1/B2/B3 via public run_baseline, plus the temporal policy-trace DSL (parse_policy_trace / evaluate_trace). Decision boundaries: expiry flip at decision_time == expiry (oracle DENY + zanzibar NOT_APPLICABLE while compiled final-state xacml still PERMITs), version-skew boundary inclusive at decision_time (bump at dt-1 ADMIT, at dt REJECT with B3_POLICY_VERSION_SKEW_DIVERGENCE), unknown principal NOT_APPLICABLE (never silently DENY) and DSL UNESTABLISHED_AUTHORITY INDETERMINATE (never a permit). Race scenarios: delegation-expiry race REJECTed by B2+B3 but ADMITted by B0+B1, healed by regrant back to ADMIT under every arm; policy-skew race REJECTed by B3 alone while B0/B1/B2 all ADMIT. Two-step metamorphic relations over seeded randomized corpora (random.Random per-trial fixed seeds; no global seeding, no wall clock): M1 appending a REVOKE for the requesting key can never mint a PERMIT (oracle + all engines; revoking can only reduce access); M2 after the appended REVOKE both compiled final-state engines answer DENY and Zanzibar never gains a permit; M3 appending a POLICY_VERSION_BUMP at t >= decision time only tightens conformance detection (B3 REJECT stays REJECT, engine decisions and oracle verdict unchanged; adding a policy version can only tighten conformance detection); M4 time-shift invariance (constant shift of all logical times/expiry/decision time preserves oracle, zanzibar and DSL verdicts); M5 DSL findings are append-only (every prefix (kind, witness) finding persists in the full trace); M6 DSL revocation flips later access to DENY and re-granting a revoked principal stays fail-closed (sticky revocation witnessed as REVOKED_ACTOR_TRANSITIVITY). Mutation checks (RQ2 analogue): seeded mutant corpus (expiry_tighten / revoke_drop / purpose_swap / bump_insert, >= 400 mutants) with B3's killed set a proven superset of B1's and B2's at equal budget and strictly killing temporal mutants both pointwise arms miss; every REJECT detail carries its arm's stable reason code and counted_as_success=True; full-corpus replay twice is byte-identical (determinism). DSL parse-level fail-closed boundaries (UNORDERED_TIMESTAMPS, DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP, EMPTY_TRACE, SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH, MALFORMED_EVENT, MISSING_LOGICAL_TIME) and delegation-cycle / revoke-before-grant witnesses asserted on the REAL parser. All corpus units are synthetic delegated-consent histories in monotonic logical time (no PHI/PII, no network, no live provider, no hidden clock or randomness).
